rows.text: Un Diesel può usare l’iniezione diretta: il gasolio entra nella camera principale, senza passare da una precamera.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Esistono Diesel a iniezione indiretta: il gasolio entra in una camera ausiliaria collegata a quella principale.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Nell’iniezione diretta l’iniettore spruzza il gasolio nella camera principale del cilindro, senza precamera.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Nell’iniezione indiretta il gasolio è spruzzato nella precamera, collegata alla camera principale del cilindro.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: La precamera appartiene all’iniezione indiretta. In quella diretta il gasolio entra nella camera principale del cilindro.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Il gasolio si accende grazie al calore dell’aria compressa, senza scintilla. Eventuali candelette aiutano l’avviamento a freddo, ma non producono scintille.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.
https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P1002I9D.TXT — US EPA, Emission Control Technology for Diesel Trucks: prechamber glow plugs assist cold starting.

rows.text: In generale l’iniezione indiretta è meno efficiente: la precamera comporta perdite di calore e di flusso maggiori rispetto a quella diretta.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Non si può stabilire che l’iniezione indiretta sia sempre meno inquinante: le emissioni dipendono anche dal tipo di inquinante e dalle caratteristiche del motore.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/752077/ — ORNL/TM-1999/213, glossary DI and IDI: injection locations, prechamber losses and emissions trade-offs.

rows.text: Il regolatore limita il regime intervenendo sulla quantità di gasolio erogata, così da contenere i giri entro il massimo previsto.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/10154822 — US DOE Fundamentals Handbook, Mechanical Science, diesel governor section, pp. 34–35: speed-limiting governors regulate fuel quantity to control engine speed.

rows.text: Il regolatore limita la quantità di gasolio quando il regime si avvicina al massimo, contrastando un aumento pericoloso dei giri in accelerazione.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/10154822 — US DOE Fundamentals Handbook, Mechanical Science, diesel governor section, pp. 34–35: speed-limiting governors regulate fuel quantity to control engine speed.

rows.text: Il regolatore controlla il regime variando la quantità di gasolio erogata; l’anticipo della mandata riguarda invece il momento dell’iniezione.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/10154822 — US DOE Fundamentals Handbook, Mechanical Science, diesel governor section, pp. 34–35: speed-limiting governors regulate fuel quantity to control engine speed.

rows.text: Il regolatore controlla i giri del motore; il limitatore di velocità interviene sulla velocità del veicolo. Hanno funzioni diverse.
evidence: https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/10154822 — US DOE Fundamentals Handbook, Mechanical Science, diesel governor section, pp. 34–35: speed-limiting governors regulate fuel quantity to control engine speed.
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/1992/6/oj/eng — Directive 92/6/EEC, Article 2: vehicle speed limitation devices restrict maximum road speed.

rows.text: Nel Diesel convenzionale entra aria nella fase di aspirazione; il gasolio viene iniettato successivamente e si accende per il calore della compressione.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — DOE Fundamentals Handbook, diesel engine operation: intake air, compression ignition and compression ratio.
https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.

rows.text: Il Diesel convenzionale usa normalmente un rapporto di compressione maggiore, per portare l’aria a una temperatura adatta all’accensione del gasolio.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — DOE Fundamentals Handbook, diesel engine operation: intake air, compression ignition and compression ratio.
https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.

rows.text: Nel Diesel il gasolio iniettato si autoaccende nell’aria riscaldata dalla compressione; nel motore a benzina convenzionale l’accensione avviene con una scintilla.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.

rows.text: Nel Diesel convenzionale in aspirazione entra aria; il gasolio viene iniettato successivamente, verso la fine della compressione.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — DOE Fundamentals Handbook, diesel engine operation: intake air, compression ignition and compression ratio.
https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.

rows.text: Il Diesel non richiede candele a scintilla: il gasolio iniettato si accende nell’aria calda compressa.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-diesel-cars-work — US DOE: compression heating ignites injected diesel, unlike spark ignition.

rows.text: Il Diesel ha generalmente un rendimento termico superiore, non notevolmente peggiore, anche grazie al maggiore rapporto di compressione.
evidence: https://www.energy.virginia.gov/coal/coal-mine-safety/documents/Certification/StudyGuides/DieselEngineMechanic.pdf — Virginia diesel mechanic study guide: diesel combustion and lower maximum speed than gasoline; relative efficiency.
https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — DOE Fundamentals Handbook, diesel engine operation: intake air, compression ignition and compression ratio.

rows.text: Il Diesel automobilistico opera generalmente a regimi massimi inferiori a quelli di un motore a benzina comparabile, anche per i tempi richiesti dalla combustione.
evidence: https://www.energy.virginia.gov/coal/coal-mine-safety/documents/Certification/StudyGuides/DieselEngineMechanic.pdf — Virginia diesel mechanic study guide: diesel combustion and lower maximum speed than gasoline; relative efficiency.

rows.text: Il freddo può rendere difficile l’avviamento di un Diesel perché ostacola l’accensione; le candelette possono aiutare a scaldare la camera.
evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P1002I9D.TXT — US EPA, Emission Control Technology for Diesel Trucks: prechamber glow plugs assist cold starting.

rows.text: A parità di combustibile, un rendimento maggiore significa ottenere più lavoro utile dalla stessa energia: serve quindi meno combustibile per unità di lavoro.
evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P10004Y7.TXT — US EPA, Advanced Technology Vehicle Modeling in PERE, engine efficiency and brake-specific fuel consumption; inverse relation at fixed fuel heating value.

rows.text: La benzina forma una miscela di vapori infiammabile a una temperatura più bassa del gasolio: ha quindi un punto di infiammabilità inferiore.
evidence: https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/npg/npgd0299.html — NIOSH gasoline flash point; https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/120913/cdc_120913_DS1.pdf — NIOSH diesel flash point, table 1.
https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/ershdb/glossary.html — NIOSH definition of flash point.

rows.text: Aspirazione, compressione, espansione e scarico richiedono quattro corse del pistone, corrispondenti a due giri dell’albero motore.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2013/11/f4/micropower_opp_vol1_text.pdf — US DOE, section 6.2.1: four strokes require two crankshaft revolutions.

rows.text: Il quiz indica VERO, ma la formulazione è imprecisa: la cilindrata è la somma dei volumi spazzati dai pistoni tra i due punti morti. Il volume totale sopra il pistone al punto morto inferiore comprende anche il volume residuo della camera di combustione.
evidence: Official superiori 29254 prints VERO for total cylinder volume at bottom dead centre.

ISO/DIS 2710-1 §§3.9.1.6.1–.6.4 https://www.iso.org/obp/ui?_escaped_fragment_=iso%3Astd%3Aiso%3A2710%3A-1%3Adis%3Aed-3%3Av1%3Aen : draft distinguishes swept displacement and clearance volume; author access JS-only, independently adjudicated. Draft is current terminology, not evidence of historical quiz intent.

rows.text: A parità di combustibile, se il rendimento aumenta occorre meno combustibile per produrre un’unità di lavoro utile: il consumo specifico diminuisce.
evidence: https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=P10004Y7.TXT — US EPA, Advanced Technology Vehicle Modeling in PERE, engine efficiency and brake-specific fuel consumption; inverse relation at fixed fuel heating value.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: NASA source https://www.grc.nasa.gov/WWW/K-12/BGP/stroke.html defines displacement as sum of cylinder swept volumes; NASA report https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19750064998/downloads/19750064998.pdf describes compression ratio as clearance plus displacement over clearance. ISO draft was not independently accessed.

issues.reason: The printed verdict is VERO, but the wording defines displacement as the sum of cylinder internal volumes at bottom dead centre. The authoritative definition distinguishes that total, which includes clearance volume, from displacement, the sum of swept volumes. It is unclear whether the quiz intends only the swept portion of each cylinder; this cannot be inferred as its actual wording.
checked_sources: Official superiori quiz, PDF SHA-256 a8bb47ac18788c151ba4596b4095221a4a2fce6f2cb026ffe671cf8283df9234, zero-based page 99, question 29254: printed wording and VERO verdict.

ISO/DIS 2710-1, clauses 3.9.1.6.1–3.9.1.6.4, https://www.iso.org/obp/ui?_escaped_fragment_=iso%3Astd%3Aiso%3A2710%3A-1%3Adis%3Aed-3%3Av1%3Aen: bottom-dead-centre cylinder volume equals clearance plus swept volume; engine swept volume is the sum of swept volumes.
